purpose: Minimal durable resume authority for interactive/session timeouts. Read this before repeating any LARE calculation.

active_units_without_durable_result.resume_rule: If expected result exists, do not rerun. Else inspect newest non-superseded C3B run/artifacts and aggregate only missing evidence.
If expected result exists, do not rerun. Else inspect newest non-superseded C4D case artifacts; rerun only a missing width, then aggregate.

C4B has several superseded historical runs. Ignore them unless needed for provenance. Use only the newest run compatible with live preregistration/analyzer; structured BC2_C4B_CASE_BLOCKED is a valid preregistered case outcome and must not be blindly rerun.

workflow_hardening.supersession: workflow-level concurrency with cancel-in-progress=true for C3B/C4B/C4D
workflow_hardening.case_evidence: structured JSON artifact per matrix case; C3B/C4B/C4D preserve case evidence independently of aggregate

resume_algorithm: If result exists and authority hashes remain valid: reuse it and continue.
If result does not exist: inspect latest relevant workflow artifact before launching anything.
Persist an aggregate/blocked result as soon as enough evidence exists.
Update this checkpoint before launching the next expensive scientific work unit.
Never rerun a qualified predecessor solely because chat/session context was lost.
next_state_boundary: Close/persist C3B, C4D and C4B independently. Do not wait for all three before persisting any one that completes.
